description: List every audience that references a segment, with campaign linkage. Returns audiences[] ({id, name, campaign_id, status, record_count}), audience_count, and campaign_count. Use before archiving, refreshing, or editing a segment to understand downstream impact, or when the user asks where a segment is used across campaigns. Requires 'discovery' scope.
